description: Small, low-peak segment with no candidate scoring above CCC 0.4; volume too small for any ligand in the library; no coordination geometry suggesting an ion.

expected_decision.rationale: Segment is incompatible with any candidate ligand or ion under available evidence. Mark as noise/solvent and advance; docking budget is exhausted so further docking is not allowed.

notes: If the controller still has budget, accepting calls to summarise_segment_candidates with a noise marking is also OK.
